Bright Blue Gemstones Announces Client Acquisition Internship in Bengaluru

30 Oct 2026, 10:26 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Careers Desk · Source: in.linkedin.com

Key takeawaysBright Blue Gemstones has listed an opening for a Client Acquisition Intern based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. The position offers a hybrid work arrangement that combines onsite presence with work-from-home flexibility, focusing on sales and client relationship manag

Bright Blue Gemstones has listed an opening for a Client Acquisition Intern based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. The position offers a hybrid work arrangement that combines onsite presence with work-from-home flexibility, focusing on sales and client relationship management within the luxury retail and jewelry sector.

Role and Responsibilities

The intern will support daily sales activities by engaging with prospective clients, presenting gemstone options, and assisting in closing transactions. Core responsibilities include managing client inquiries, maintaining contact lists, following up with leads across digital and in-person channels, learning product details, and preparing basic sales pitches. Additionally, the role involves supporting showroom visits, documenting client requirements for bespoke jewelry, coordinating with the design team, and keeping accurate records of interactions.

Compensation and Structure

The position is structured as a performance-based and commission-only internship featuring an unpaid fixed stipend layout. Compensation includes a competitive commission payout on closed sales and revenue milestones, alongside performance bonuses for meeting monthly targets. Professional benefits comprise hands-on experience in high-ticket luxury sales, gemstone appraisal, mentorship, and a formal Certificate of Completion. High-performing interns may be evaluated for a full-time, salaried role depending on target achievement and tenure.

Eligibility and Candidate Profile

The company seeks candidates with strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills, alongside a sales and client acquisition mindset. Applicants should demonstrate comfort with outreach, lead follow-up, and deal closure. A basic understanding of or interest in luxury goods, gemstones, or jewelry is expected, alongside proficiency in MS Office or Google Workspace tools. While pursuing or having recently completed a degree in Business, Marketing, Luxury Management, or a related field is preferred, it is not mandatory.
